title: 小溪拐了个弯
goal: 用近宽远窄的水面组织纵深
scene: A SMALL shallow creek enters bottom center broad, bends left and narrows into upper third, pale cyan water with a few blue-green horizontal dashes and white highlights reserved. Two warm beige banks, one ochre stone at near left, sparse muted-teal grasses at right, pale gray-green distant bank and olive shrub. No bridge, waterfall, mountains or reflections of complex objects. Bright open sky mainly white. Moderate sunny depth study.
decision: 先安排溪流形状，再决定两岸植物，水纹远处更少
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D3 integrated composition, 2-3 layers, moderate detail.
